request.style: English, Male baritone voice, solo with backing choir, electric guitar, distorted bass, drums, 90 BPM, anthemic and uplifting rock
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I am afflicted in my pain
My spirit feels the weight
But your salvation O God
Will lift me high today

[Chorus]
I will praise the name of God with song
I will magnify him with thanksgiving
This will please the LORD more than an ox
More than a bull with horns and hooves

[Verse]
The humble will see it and be glad
You who seek God let your hearts revive
For the LORD hears the needy truly
And does not despise his own in chains

[Chorus]
I will praise the name of God with song
I will magnify him with thanksgiving
This will please the LORD more than an ox
More than a bull with horns and hooves

[Bridge]
Lift me high out of my pain
Your praise is the sweetest sound
My soul will rejoice in your name
In this holy and sacred ground

[Chorus]
I will praise the name of God with song
I will magnify him with thanksgiving
This will please the LORD more than an ox
More than a bull with horns and hooves

[Outro]
Lift me high with your song
Magnify him with thanksgiving
